NEWKUNLUN-DETONATE.title: Detonate
NEWKUNLUN-DISCHARGE.description:
Spend X [gold]Qi Charges[/gold] or as many as you have, whichever is fewer.
The associated effect is conditional on spend.

Mark the enemy with your [gold]Talisman[/gold]
[gold]Talisman[/gold] disappears after 2 turns, when you [gold]Mark[/gold] again, or when you [gold]Detonate[/gold].

NEWKUNLUN-PRECISEPARRY.title: Precise Parry
NEWKUNLUN-RELOAD.description:
Load an [gold]Azure Sand Magazine[/gold].
Add the [gold]Azure Bow[/gold] to your hand if not in your deck.

Increase the power of the [gold]Azure Bow[/gold].
